criteria.scopeDescription: For a fixed category, verify ordered page contents, size bounds, and empty overflow with filtered total. The service check directly covers ordinary and overflow pages. The API delegates on a cache miss (artifact-2 L10-L14), but only the fixed-category API pagination check can supply the required integration evidence. Its test definition alone supplies no execution result.

evidenceReviews.rationale: The offered unit observation names the service filter test and matches its exact-category, total and case-sensitive assertions.
The offered service unit test passed both its ordered books-page assertion and its full tools-overflow response assertion.
The named integration check passed for identical tuples, including the assertion that the cache has one entry. It varies no input.
The selection check starts on page 1, asserts view state and returned IDs, and has an offered passing integration result.
The failing assertion in the offered trace identifies the page field immediately after selection. The next items assertion was not reached.
The offered failure compares the recorded outbound tuple to the expected tuple at the assertion in artifact-8.
The observed second request returned book IDs at the tools assertion on a shared instance. The subsequent total assertion was not reached.

risk.rationale: A stale page or a wrong cached category can show an empty list or unrelated catalog rows. The synthetic public catalog is local and reversible. Stateful integration checks are needed at both transitions.
